scope: 37 previously deprecated global controls. Same-named section/block settings and all saved owner state remain.

inactive_header_chain.proof: After masking comments/schema, only header-two-mobile-menu renders header-two-logo. No layout/section/block/snippet renders header-two-mobile-menu. Dynamic render block calls are app blocks, not arbitrary snippet names.

platform_review.decision: These 37 theme-authored IDs are not required platform metadata or settings. Keep theme_info and supported local features. Conditional visibility is documented for supported types, but none of these controls has a live compatibility need, so no visible_if workaround is needed.

group_cleanup: Remove empty Blog (global), Collection, Single Product and Analytics IDs headers.
Rename checkout-note heading/label to Cart summary note; its only consumer is the cart summary.
Label active marketing_consent_mode as Form consent metadata; transport semantics remain explicit.
Review all 13 groups; retain small groups with actual supported functions.
